verdict.rationale: Pipecat ships a first-party MCP server: `pipecat context-hub install` registers the hub as an MCP server with your coding agent. The runtime probe confirms the official CLI includes context-hub, a local docs, examples and API index built for coding agents. Its scope is limited to that knowledge index, and the evidence documents no deeper product operations. missing for 10: documentation of the exposed MCP tools/resources, MCP access to Pipecat Cloud or runtime operations, independent hands-on corroboration of agents using the server

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: pipecat context-hub install registers the hub as an MCP server with your coding agent and builds the local index
context-hub (local docs/examples/API index built for coding agents)
